headline: Reproducible pipelines and benchmarks reshape spatial transcriptomics analysis
label: Spatial Transcriptomics Analysis Methods
summary: Benchmarks and standardized workflows now test spatial clustering, cell annotation, and Xenium preprocessing across platforms.
synthesis: The dominant thread is standardization of spatial and single-cell analysis. SCORPy offers a code-free desktop route to single-cell proteomic analysis of multiplexed imaging data, with new background correction, and nf_xpatial packages Xenium QC, normalization, multi-sample integration and clustering as a Nextflow pipeline. SACCELERATOR standardizes spatially aware clustering benchmarks and adds a consensus workflow that flags method disagreement, while a benchmark of 20 cell type annotation methods across four spatial transcriptomics platforms and six scenarios reports scANVI, Seurat and TACCO ranking highest. The new element is explicit attention to reproducibility and method disagreement rather than single-method claims. Other items, including a Perturb-seq study of hematopoietic progenitors, a long-read atlas of fibroblast-to-hematopoietic reprogramming, and a multi-omics protocol for a glioma model, apply single-cell and sequencing approaches to biological questions without the same methodological focus.
